scope: Every Commercial Expert Order×Material is a mart row (MOGH_ITEM_ROLE FIRST/ADDITIONAL/NO_ORDER) and enters every calculation; case-level facts are counted once per case (grain.case_rows).
business_logic_change_note: Mart grain changed from one row per expert order to one row per expert Order×Material (owner's decision). Material-level measures now include every expert material; case-level measures (red commitments, demurrage average, conformance, commitment register, scorecard, BL-grain safe_agg, cashflow PI registration) count each case once. Pre-existing scorecard bug fixed: BL-less cases were collapsed into one arbitrary row.

validation.this_release_result: 1530 passed, 0 failed (working tree); re-verified from the clean ZIP extraction
validation.ab_test: tools/ab, 29.15.10 vs 29.15.11 on identical inputs: reproduction data (owner's cases) — mart 8→10 rows, none lost, commitment totals / red commitments / deviating cases identical, every other change traced to the two new rows; 40x scaled data (2 runs) — no calculation changed; treatment arm (5 runs) — identical except the scorecard in the half-source run (pre-existing bug fixed: 81 of 82 experts with BL-less cases were missing)

source_authority_change_note: The Commercial Expert file is the population criterion for materials: every Order×Material, including incomplete and order-less lines, is a mart row. BLs still come only from independent sources and attach to the order's first material; expert data still never sets operational position.
